items.q: there was a Rube Wolfe at the Paramount that had a band there

ctx.x: Yes, and during that time there was other bands, other Mexican bands and and Black bands and a . . . In all the different theaters -- there was a Rube Wolfe at the Paramount that had a band there. And . . .
What about the Spike Brothers? The Spike Brothers?
